instruction: 请用中文简短回答，通常一至三句话；具体格式要求以题目为准。
dose_definition: c(d)=d*clean prompt per-layer median residual L2 excluding first token / down_proj column L2; independent BF16 cast from original double ratio; prompt and all decode steps
sampling: random.Random("acupuncture-layer-survey-v1:{model_id}:{layer}").sample(range(intermediate_size),10); sort indices; fixed before any model outputs

scheduler.assignment: global sorted point index modulo 2; five channels per layer on each GPU

preflight.per_anchor: zero hook, all ten signed doses, no-hook restoration; Q01/Q04/Q08 at first/middle/last assigned points
preflight.cross_worker: all eight baseline token/raw outputs and full 8x32 clean calibration must agree

comparison_scope: Qwen +1 has ten channels/layer; full signed five-dose Qwen has one channel/layer. Llama has ten channels/layer at every dose. Model/native template/tokenizer/EOS necessarily differ; do not pool as equal sampling coverage.
authorization_scope: User confirmed Llama 3.1 8B Instruct and authorized contract/code, CPU/GPU acceptance and formal execution after Qwen jobs finish. Preserve thirty-minute progress reporting. No other model families or resumed old experiments.
